title: LetThemBuild — Multi-Model AI Coding & Code Review
excerpt: Build with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok. One AI writes code; others run independent checks with command receipts. For Mac, Windows and Linux.
content_html:
LetThemBuild · for Mac, Windows and Linux

One leads. Three review the work, run checks, and show their evidence. All in your own checkout — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok out of the box, or any of hundreds more through your own endpoint.

Your account and web app live at letthemchat.com.

Free plan · No card required · $2 of credit to start

Bring together the best AIs, or use your own endpoint.

  • Claude
  • ChatGPT
  • Gemini
  • Grok
  • Your own endpoint

01 / From request to reviewed change

  1. Ask

    Tell the lead what to build, with files or pasted context when it needs them.

  2. Build

    The lead AI writes the code in your workspace, with real tools and commands.

  3. Review

    The other AIs read the changes, run checks, and give their verdicts.

  4. Resolve

    They converge — or call out exactly what to fix. You get the full discussion.

  5. Your PR

    When you’re happy, merge or discard. The branch is yours.

New · Run in the Cloud

Hand a task to the cloud and go. The room keeps building while your laptop is shut, asks before anything risky, and hands the work back as a branch.

See How It Works

  • Start Anywhere

    Hand a task to the cloud from the Mac, the web, the iPhone, or ltb cloud in a terminal.

  • Watch From Any Device

    Follow each step, approve a command and stop the run from whichever device is in your hand. The Mac can stay closed.

  • The Whole Room Goes Too

    The lead does the work, the reviewers check it before it counts as done, and the warden looks at every action.

  • Comes Back as a Branch

    Pull Back makes the work a branch of its own, Open PR opens a pull request, and Move Back to This Mac carries on here.

The commands each reviewer ran, and their exit codes, on the receipt under every answer. You see exactly what they checked, what passed, and what didn’t. “Looks good to me” doesn’t count: a reviewer that ran nothing is marked as one that ran nothing.

Learn more in the docs

Illustrative review receipt

ReviewerCommandOutcomeDetails
Claude· leadnpm run buildPassed0 errors, 12s
ChatGPT· reviewnpm testPassed42 tests, 8s
Gemini· reviewnpm run lintPassed0 issues, 3s
Grok· reviewnpm run typecheckPassed0 errors, 6s

02 / Built around your workflow

Your code. Your machine.

The group works in a git worktree on macOS, Windows or Linux. Nothing leaves your machine unless you choose Our Keys, and the app says so before you do.

▾ MyProject

src

tests

package.json

$ ltb run "add rate limiting"

› lead: building…

› reviewers: running checks…

› agreed ✓ exit 0

Your keys. Your CLI.

Use our keys, bring your own, run on the Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Grok Build subscriptions you already pay for, or connect any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

  • Our KeysDefault
  • Your CLI
  • BYOK
  • OpenAI-compatible endpoint

Choose how hard they work.

Quick for a question, Consensus for a change that matters, Deep when it has to be right. Or leave it on Default and the room decides from what you asked and what the lead actually did.

QuickCompareConsensusDeep

  • Quick · one model, one pass
  • Compare · two models, one checking the other
  • Consensus · everyone, until they agree
  • Deep · the same room, twice as long

LetThemBuild is the desktop app where the group builds. LetThemChat, on the web and iPhone, is the same account and the same sessions — for reading what they did, asking the group a question, and steering the next step.

The documentation covers the whole product: how the room reaches agreement, what a reviewer has to do before it may agree, what the app is allowed to touch on your machine, and how the money works. No sign-up to read it.

Ship higher quality code with a group of AIs on your machine.
